title: Household, Crew, Crowd, Population, Herd/Pack/Swarm & Ecosystem-Cohort Generation
objective: Add bounded household, crew, crowd, population, herd/pack/swarm and ecosystem-cohort generation over authoritative entity, social, settlement/environment and population owner records without creating duplicate population/group ledgers or silently canonicalizing generated cohorts.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded multi-entity/cohort generation adapters over completed MNCS candidate/composition layers while retaining authoritative owner-domain group, population, settlement/environment and entity truth.
scope.completion_gate: Eligible group/cohort proposals can be generated deterministically from authoritative references without creating duplicate canonical population/group/entity ledgers or auto-promoting generated members/cohorts to canon.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-14 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-14-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-15 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
Character/NPC/Creature, relationship/social, settlement/environment and population/group owner domains retain canonical entity/group/population truth; MNCS-15 generates proposals/adapters only.
Generated household/crew/crowd/population/herd/pack/swarm/ecosystem cohorts do not automatically become canonical and cannot create a second population/group ledger.
Missing or unresolved cohort facts must remain unresolved rather than being invented.
MNCS-15 absorbs baseline MNCS-15/16/17 plus the documented MNCS-09 household/group context and MNCS-23 population batch residuals.
MNCS-15 is governed-started on branch work/mncs-15-cohort-generation from fresh application main 496fd4cf886d8eac674dafab5f95f3592ea7e3da; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
All parallel lane states are preserved exactly from fresh CURRENT.json and remain independently governed.
next_action: Establish causal RED for deterministic group/cohort proposal generation over authoritative references, unresolved-safe cohort facts, no canonical promotion, no duplicate group/population ledger, and local-first operation; then implement only bounded MNCS-15 behavior through proof, publication and closeout.
